title: An estimate sent before Convert to No Charge shows the change on its next open
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login and email the tester can use.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billable, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours, sent to the portal.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Convert to No Charge".
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Click the confirming Convert to No Charge button.
  6. Sign in to the customer portal as customer A's contact.
  7. Open work order 1's estimate in the portal.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Convert to No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • The "No Charge" badge shows.

Step 6:

  • The portal opens.
  • No new email has arrived in the contact's mailbox.

Step 7:

  • The same estimate shows the NO CHARGE stamp and no prices.
  • Under the lines the notice reads "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current."
  • The "Approval Required" email the contact received before the conversion still shows the old prices.
  • The print preview of the portal estimate shows no stale document with prices.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12296 (Story 12 (portal), The no-charge line in the customer portal)

  • S2-E6: “If an estimate was already sent to the portal, or IBS approval requested, before the work order is converted to no charge, the portal shows the updated estimate with the NO CHARGE stamp on its next open and no call goes to IBS: ShopView can request an approval and a new request replaces the amount, it cannot withdraw one, so an earlier request stays as it was and the IBS card is hidden on internal and no-charge work orders because nothing is left to approve. No new email is sent; the customer sees the live state on the same link and the advisor re-sends when a fresh document is wanted. The notice "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current." shows under the lines (S12-R4).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Portal estimate changed after it was sent | "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current." | Notice under the lines on the portal estimate (S2-E6, S12-R4)”
